releases.evidence: Official PDF page 1: annual composite index 106.2; page 4: food products annual growth 6.2. Prior July annual rates 6.4 appear in both charts. Monthly 100.2 is independently reconciled to SIAT 4585.

Official National Statistics Committee September 2026 CPI release, published 5 October 2026: page 1 composite annual index 106.4 and monthly index 100.7; page 4 food products annual index 106.3. August annual growth is 6.2 for both headline CPI (page 1 chart) and food products (page 4 chart). Monthly index 100.7 is independently reconciled to the September SIAT 4585 aggregate.
